item.title: Kathie Lee Gifford's Surprising Year of Pain and Resilience
item.description:
Kathie Lee Gifford says she feels “like Mr. Potato Head” — and at 72, the beloved TV legend has earned the right to joke about it.

In a candid new PEOPLE cover story, the former Today co-host pulled back the curtain on what may be the hardest year of her life: a cascade of surgeries, fractures, and chronic pain so severe she admits she “wanted to die.” Yet she greeted the interview the way she’s greeted five decades in the spotlight — cracking jokes and refusing to quit.

item.title: Jenna Bush Hager's Surprising New Era: From Today Show to Hollywood Powerhouse
item.description:
Jenna Bush Hager’s Surprising New Era: From Today Show to Hollywood Powerhouse

What happens when the daughter of a former U.S. president becomes one of the busiest women in American television? You get the Jenna Bush Hager moment we are living in right now — and it is more layered than the morning-show smile suggests.

Quick Summary: Jenna Bush Hager just scored a major NBC pickup for her drama Line of Fire, broke down on live television about working-mom guilt, opened up about perimenopause at 44, and is still anchoring the Fourth Hour of Today. Behind the polish, she is publicly admitting: “things are falling apart.”
